svg.title: Known-best packing of 132 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=132 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete rational centre/half-angle certificate of PR 574 at 4c319c2, read exactly from a release asset whose size and SHA-256 a manifest of that commit pins, and, for a v2 certificate, equal there to the source's own corners Witness/v2; no upstream byte is retained. Finite construction feasibility only; a padding reduction of a packing others found, with no novelty, priority, local minimum, rigidity or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=132 known best: side ~ 11.9856802 (certified upper bound)
